suggestions.content:
### Vendor claim without confirmation (ubs.com)

- **Misleading Signal**: Vendor claim from ubs.com: UBS has detailed EMIR Refit compliance information on their website showing trad...
- **Reality**: Vendor press release; bank has not confirmed CDM usage in this scope
- **Why It Confuses**: Vendor marketing appears authoritative but may overstate bank's CDM adoption
- **Lesson**: Require bank-side confirmation for vendor claims before classifying as production_usage
- **Banks affected**: ubs
- **Time wasted**: ~30 minutes

### Historical pilot without follow-through

- **Misleading Signal**: Historical pilot: UBS participated in ISDA/ASX/Digital Asset CDM clearing pilot for interest rate ...
- **Reality**: Pilot participation did not lead to current production adoption
- **Why It Confuses**: Historical pilot activity suggests momentum that may have stalled
- **Lesson**: Check for sustained follow-through post-pilot; look for evidence within last 2 years
- **Banks affected**: ubs
- **Time wasted**: ~45 minutes
